scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Grid bots → capture oscillation in range-bound major pairs, fully automated.
DeFi lending / stable LP → earn on idle stablecoins and reserves.
Staking / LSTs → earn on assets you'd hold anyway.
Concentrated LP → earn fees on-chain in ranges, for larger, self-custodied sizes.
scenes.vo: Each tool is good at a different job: The trap: correlation. An ETH grid bot + an ETH/U.S.D.C. L.P. + an liquid staking token loop are three bets on ETH staying in a range. If ETH breaks down, they all lose together. Add up your exposure by underlying asset and by range, not by number of positions. First, Grid bots to capture oscillation in range-bound major pairs, fully automated. Next, DeFi lending or stable L.P. to earn on idle stablecoins and reserves. Then, Staking or liquid staking token to earn on assets you'd hold anyway. And finally, Concentrated L.P. to earn fees on-chain in ranges, for larger, self-custodied sizes.
scenes.cap: Each tool is good at a different job: The trap: correlation. An ETH grid bot + an ETH/USDC LP + an LST loop are three bets on ETH staying in a range. scenes.vo: Percentages are an example structure, not a recommendation. Set your own from your risk budget. Rules for this system: Reserve, 15%, Stablecoin lending (split across 2 protocols), Liquidity to defend positions and redeploy after range breaks. Core yield, 25%, Stable-stable L.P. or stable lending, Base return on cash. Hold-anyway assets, 25%, Staking or liquid staking token, Earn on long-term holdings. Range income, 30%, Grid bots on liquid majors (+ optional wide on-chain L.P.), Capture oscillation. Speculative, at most 5%, Burner-wallet farms, airdrops, new protocols, Capped experiments.

scenes.q: ETH grid bot + ETH/USDC LP + ETH LST loop. How many independent bets?
scenes.a: Essentially one: ETH staying in range or rising. They're correlated.
